source.note: README WOTS meshlet section: M_Env_Glass_Water (no blending) forward meshlets, then a character's v_chara_tear part (AForwardPreTransform, no blending), then M_Env_Glass_OutSide (blending) forward meshlets; one of each, so the order within a group is the objects' (no capture shows two)

executable.note: README 'The forward blending order of five executables': one key per via.render.Mesh, ~trunc(clamp(z/w, 0, 1) x 4294967295) of its world box's centre (bones' boxes for a skinned mesh) moved by TransparentBias, plus the material's TransparentPriorityBias, stable ascending
